purpose: Diagnose whether the pinned TP=2 server/parser can complete a structured tool loop when the API names each function explicitly, after the single auto-choice attempt returned no tool call.
diagnosticDifference: Only the canary API request mode changes: named function tool_choice for read_file and write_file, then tool_choice=none for the final response. Server/model arguments, fixture, sampling, seed and TP=2 are unchanged.
passCriteria: read_file named call has an ID and requests exactly source.txt
write_file named call has an ID, requests exactly result.txt, and carries the exact source bytes
final none-mode completion is non-empty and has no tool call
result bytes equal the fixture and API key/raw generated text are not stored
service is stopped, logs are redacted mode 0600, and port 18142 is free
interpretationLimit: A pass proves the named-function server/parser path for this fixture, not spontaneous tool selection under auto. A failure blocks the current server profile from Tool-Eval. No adoption claim follows either way.
failurePolicy: One diagnostic run, no automatic retry and no Tool-Eval. Analyze the receipt/log before planning another change.
